author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Vibe managing doesn't work

I setup my AI to generate daily report on EVERY work of my team, commits, Jira, document updates, meeting minutes.  Then I ask the AI to give me a weekly summary.   The AI gives me something more or less random.  The stupid AI thinks a task with 5 commits is more important than the task with only 1 commit.

At the end of the day, you still need to have weekly human meeting to know what's going on that are truly important.
